text: At its meeting held on July 4, 2018, North York Community Council rescinded the parking prohibition in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Bainbridge Avenue, from Bathurst Street to a point 133 metres west (NY32.52). Local residents thought the parking prohibition was too strict and requested that parking be permitted for the statutory maximum period of three hours on that portion of the street. However, since the changes were signed on-street, residents have requested that the 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, parking prohibition be reinstated on the north side of Bainbridge Avenue, between a point 113 metres west of Bathurst Street and a point 133 metres west of Bathurst Street.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Bainbridge Avenue, between a point 113 metres west of Bathurst Street and a point 133 metres west of Bathurst Street.
